title: One Chair, One Lamp, Nine Pages
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（生活与学习·学校与教育）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（生活与学习·学校与教育）　|　核心词汇：study　|　正文 389 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 study 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: My grandfather kept a ① study at the back of the house, one window, one chair, one lamp, and he ② studied Latin in it for eleven years without ever sitting an examination. He said a study should have one chair in it and no more, because a room with three chairs is a room where a person is expected to talk.

His ③ studies, as he called them, were Latin on Mondays and Thursdays and nothing at all on the other five days, and he kept this up from 1961 to 1972. In 1974 somebody published a ④ study of the same grammar he had been reading, four hundred pages, and he bought it, read nine pages of it, and put it on the floor beside the chair, where it stayed a year unread. He never studied anything he did not mean to finish, and he said a study begun is a debt.

He ⑤ studied that book for a week before he said anything about it, which was his way; he looked at a thing the way other people read it, and he studied it again every Thursday for a month. He said the man had got the subjunctive wrong on page two hundred, and that a study of nine pages can beat a study of four hundred. My grandmother said the man had four hundred pages and my grandfather had nine; my grandfather said that was not the point.

His ⑥ studies, meaning what he actually knew, were narrow and deep: one grammar, one poet, one period. He never ⑦ made a study of anything else, and when I asked him why, he said a person who would study everything is interested only in being interested. I was sixteen and thought that stupid.

I ⑧ studied for eleven examinations in that house and remember almost nothing of them. He never once asked what I was studying and never once asked what I got. In 1989, a year after he died, a ⑨ study came out of the university two counties away which said the subjunctive had been got wrong for a hundred years and gave his reading of it. He had been right on page two hundred, and the study proved it. The ⑩ study of a thing, he had written on the flyleaf of his grammar, is not the same as the having of it.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 学习；读书；学业
B. n. （一项）研究；研究报告
D. n. 研究科目；学问（常用复数 studies）
F. v. 端详；仔细察看；审视
G. 固定搭配：make a study of ... 对……作研究
H. 固定搭配：study for ... 为……（考试）而复习

items.q: kept a study at the back of the house
he studied Latin in it for eleven years
His studies, as he called them
somebody published a study of the same grammar
He studied that book for a week
His studies, meaning what he actually knew
He never made a study of anything else
a study came out of the university two counties
The study of a thing, he had written

answers.why: a study 意为“书房”，祖父在屋后有一间书房，一扇窗、一把椅子、一盏灯。
studied 是动词，意为“学习、攻读”，他在里面学了十一年拉丁语，一场考试也没参加过。
his studies 意为“他的学习、读书”，按他自己的说法，他的学习是周一和周四读拉丁语。
a study 意为“（一项）研究、研究著作”，1974 年有人出版了一部研究同一本语法书的著作。
studied 意为“端详、仔细察看”，他把那本书端详了一星期才开口评论。
his studies 意为“他的研究科目、学问”，指的是他真正懂的那点东西：一本语法、一位诗人、一个时期。
make a study of ... 意为“对……作研究”，他从不研究别的任何东西。
study for ... 意为“为……而复习备考”，我在那栋房子里为十一次考试复习过。
a study 意为“一项研究、研究报告”，1989 年两个县之外的大学出了一份研究报告。
the study of a thing 意为“对一件事物的学习、研究”，他在语法书扉页上写道：对一件事物的研究不等于拥有它。
